title: Mirror Reflection
description: Find the receptor hit by a laser in a square room of side p given reflection distance q.
pseudocode:
1. while p % 2 == 0 and q % 2 == 0:
2.     p /= 2
3.     q /= 2
4. if p % 2 == 0: return 2
5. if q % 2 == 0: return 0
6. return 1

steps.note: Initial state with p=2, q=1. Check if both are even.
p=2 is even, implying the ray hits the reflection point 2.
